title: AI solves the Navier-Stokes equations in 88 hours
summary: Unnamed guest tells of AI solves the Navier-Stokes equations in 88 hours, about 2026 at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The fact that it only took um 80 what was it? 88 hours to solve it. That stumped mathematicians for hundreds of years.

plain: An unnamed researcher, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels in 2026, says that an artificial intelligence solved the Navier-Stokes equations, the famous maths that describes how liquids and gases flow, in only 88 hours. The researcher points out that these equations had stumped mathematicians for hundreds of years. It is told as a sign of how strange and powerful AI has become, which the episode likens to alien technology.
